title: Runwal Enterprises IPO Details
intro:
Runwal Enterprises IPO is a book build issue of ₹500.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.64 crore shares of ₹500.00 crore.

Runwal Enterprises IPO opens for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the Runwal Enterprises IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. Runwal Enterprises IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

Runwal Enterprises IPO is set issue price band at ₹290 to ₹305 per share. The lot size for an application is 49 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,945 (49 shares) (based on upper price).

ICICI Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Runwal Enterprises IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2016, Runwal Enterprises Limited is a real estate developer present across the full spectrum of real estate development. The company specializes in residential projects across the affordable, mid-income, and luxury segments, as well as in the development of commercial spaces, retail malls, and educational buildings.

As of September 30, 2024, Runwal Enterprises Limited has 15 completed projects, 25 ongoing projects, and 32 upcoming projects. The residential portfolio includes an aggregate Developable Area and Estimated Developable Area of 48.71 million square feet across completed, ongoing, and upcoming projects.

In the Eastern Suburbs submarket, the company launched approximately 4,688 units and sold around 4,198 units between January 2019 and September 2024. In the Kalyan-Dombivli submarket, Runwal Enterprises Limited ranked as the top developer in new launches and sales during the same period, launching approximately 16,043 units and selling approximately 11,481 units.
As of September 30, 2024, Runwal Enterprises Limited (including its subsidiaries) had 791 permanent employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Runwal Enterprises IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Runwal Enterprises IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Runwal Enterprises IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Runwal Enterprises IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Runwal Enterprises IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Runwal Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Runwal Enterprises IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Runwal Enterprises IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 1, 2026 . Check the Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Runwal Enterprises IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Runwal Enterprises IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Oct 5, 2026 .
